title: Certificate JWS payload profile (v1)
description:
The signed payload of a certificate. Header is fixed: `{"alg":"ES256","kid":"psn-{env}-{yyyy}-{n}","typ":"application/psn-cert+jws","cty":"application/json"}`; the payload is canonicalised with RFC 8785 (JCS) before signing, the compact serialisation IS the certificate, and `SHA-256(compact JWS string)` is the hash that enters the transparency log (FS08-050). Keys are born non-exportable inside the movement's own Key Vault and only one principal may sign (FS-00 §6.4, FS-00 §3).

VERIFICATION ORDER (published in the Trust Center, CERT-025): resolve `kid` in the JWKS → verify ES256 over the compact JWS → check `SHA-256(jws)` appears in the transparency log → fetch the certificate record for live status. Steps 1–2 work fully offline with a JWKS copy. A signature that verifies while its hash is ABSENT from the log renders UNVERIFIED — that is the rogue-issuance detector, not a soft warning (CERT-030).

FUNDING TRUTH (CERT-002/013, D14, COM-066): `amountMinor` + `cur` appear ONLY where money actually moved, and never without `amountKind`, which distinguishes a fee paid from an impact figure routed from a documented donation. One payload never conflates them. A waived organisation that funded nothing can only ever hold `license-status.waiver`.

MATERIALITY (CERT-014/054, D15): a per-contributor monetary figure enters the payload only if it meets the published floor for the attested period; otherwise the payload carries `impactBelowFloor: true` and no figure at all, so a template cannot leak a gated number it never received (FS08-091). No field can express a cross-contributor ranking (CERT-015 by construction).

At P-M2 only `supporter.entitlement` and `license-status.*` are issuable, by an operator-run signing script with the same profile (FS08-040/041). Impact figures do not exist before the first disbursed ledger row (NEV-017).

x-psn.artifactPath: (compact JWS; embedded in the PDF and in the certificate record's `jws` field)
x-psn.producer: FS-08 signer (P-M2: operator script tools/cert-sign, VS-27)
consumers: offline verifiers with a JWKS copy

cid.description: Certificate ULID. Non-guessable by construction, and the verify route is rate-limited against scraping (CERT-010/026).

typ.description: The frozen type enum (FS-00 §6.4). Not to be confused with the JWS header's `typ`, which is the media type.

variant.description: Additive discriminator from the FS08-010 table. Permitted combinations: contributor→participation; steward→registration|impact; supporter→entitlement|gift-funder|waived-funder|donation; license-status→waiver|under-threshold|gifted-pass; topup→x2|x5|x10. The combination is enforced by the `allOf` rules below and by issuance-time gates.

sub.description: Display name: a legal name for organisations, a GitHub login (or explicitly supplied legal name) for individuals. NEVER an email address (CERT-012).

subId.description: Subject id: a `co_` ULID for a company, otherwise a GitHub user or repository node_id.

scope.description: Structured scope — the same shape the entitlement record uses, so a certificate and its entitlement describe coverage identically.

band.description: Self-certified size band, corporate types only, carrying NO currency prefix (FS08-060a). Printed as given.

amountMinor.description: Integer minor units (FS-00 §6.1). Present ONLY where funded, and only together with `cur` and `amountKind`.

amountKind.description: What the amount IS. A fee renders as a fee, never as a donation (D17/CERT-054c); the donate-direct lane is the only place `donation` states a documented fact. Templates bind money slots only to a field carrying this label and compute nothing themselves (FS08-091).

period.description: Attested period. Expiry is non-destructive: an expired certificate verifies as 'was valid for period P' (CERT-041), consistent with vesting permanence (D12).

iat.description: Issued-at, seconds since the Unix epoch (RFC 7519 NumericDate).

iss.description: Issuer. Production certificates use the production issuer; sandbox certificates use the `/sandbox` issuer, sign with sandbox keys, publish only at the sandbox JWKS and NEVER enter the transparency log (FS08-103, COM-086).

claimKitVersion.description: Pins the claim-language kit in force at issuance (D17). The kit document is published alongside this contract set and at `/kits/{version}.json`.

verify.description: The human verify URL for this certificate. The frozen exclusive-verification wording printed on every artifact is 'verify only at purposesource.org/verify' (FS-00 §6.4 as amended 2026-09-01, CERT-027): the human verify page owns that statement, and machine endpoints are documented separately, never printed as the canonical host.

factRefs.description: The recorded facts this certificate attests, by immutable id. No anticipatory certificates exist: a reference to a non-existent or non-settled fact fails the issuance gate (CERT-004, FS08-012).

supersedes.description: Renewal chain (CERT-046). Payloads are never mutated: a renewal is a NEW certificate that links back.

percentileBand.description: Contributor payloads only. Purpose-Points-based, never money-based — no field in this schema can express a monetary ranking (CERT-015).

categoryVotes.description: Contributor payloads only: which category funds this contributor directed. 'Helped direct', never received (MKT-037).

impactMinor.description: Contributor impact figure, minor units. Present only when the materiality floor is met AND a ledger row exists; always accompanied by `cur` and `amountKind: "impact-routed"` (FS08-090).

impactBelowFloor.description: True when the attested period's figure is below the published materiality floor. The payload then carries NO monetary figure at all (D15/CERT-054b).

claims.description: The machine-readable claim-language kit block (CERT-050). Corporate types embed the kit as an integral page of the rendered PDF including the binding statement on the certificate face (CERT-053). `license-status` certificates carry the STATUS-ONLY kit variant: coverage-status wording exclusively, with no supporter or impact phrasing anywhere (CERT-052, MKT-034).

translations.description: Counsel-approved renderings (DE/FR ship at P-M3, CERT-056). Each is marked an approved rendering with English controlling, and the renderer always includes the English kit.

then.$comment: CERT-052/D14: a status certificate attests status only. No amount may appear on it — a waived organisation that actually funded something gets a separate supporter.waived-funder certificate (COM-066).

allOf.$comment: D15/CERT-054b: the below-floor flag and a monetary figure are mutually exclusive.
